name: bbox-ui
description: A shadcn-style component registry of presentational components for black-box system design (blocks, ports, edges). Extends the React Flow UI idea.

scripts.build: pnpm -r run typecheck && pnpm -r run build && pnpm run registry:build
scripts.demo:all: pnpm --parallel --filter demo-reactflow --filter demo-tldraw --filter demo-compare --filter bbox-playground run dev
